game.name: N.O.V.A. 3: Near Orbit Vanguard Alliance
game.desc: The 2012 mobile science-fiction first-person shooter by Gameloft. Port by EapRules. It runs the original Android ARM library directly through a bionic/JNI compatibility loader. Supply your own v1.0.7 APK plus both OBB expansion files; the first launch imports them automatically.
